name: Old Grandpa Skinpack
summary: These are grandpas. It seems like there is more than just old stories behind those wrinkled smiles ...
legend: Nobody in the village remembers the grandpas arriving. They were just there one morning, sitting on the bench by the well as if they'd been waiting for a hundred years. Opa Herbert wears a teal shirt that looks a lot like someone else's, and he won't say where he got it. Opa Guenther strokes his thick grey beard and tells stories about strongholds that aren't on any map. Opa Friedrich just watches the horizon with pale blue eyes, like he's counting the sunsets he has left. At night their lanterns stay lit long after the villagers have gone to sleep. Sometimes you can hear them laughing about the old days, back before the first creeper ever hissed. Some people say they built this world. Others say they're still guarding something underneath it. Every winter, one more chair turns up by the fire...

skins.name: Opa Herbert
skins.story: Opa Herbert wears a teal shirt and purple trousers and swears he dressed like that before any hero ever spawned.

skins.name: Opa Clarence
skins.story: Opa Clarence has a bald head, grey tufts, a dark beard and a rust-brown shirt, and he remembers every block he ever mined.

skins.name: Opa Friedrich
skins.story: Opa Friedrich has bushy white hair, pale blue eyes and a green shirt, and he stares at the horizon like he's expecting someone.

skins.name: Opa Takeshi
skins.story: Opa Takeshi has thinning grey hair and a quiet olive-brown tunic, and he speaks rarely, but every word lands like a stone.

skins.name: Opa Guenther
skins.story: Opa Guenther strokes his great grey beard in his red shirt and tells tales of strongholds no map has ever shown.

versions.note: The first five grandpas take their seats by the village well: Herbert, Clarence, Friedrich, Takeshi and Guenther.

skins.name: Opa Gunter
skins.story: Opa Gunter has white hair, rosy cheeks and purple overalls with a teal collar, and he smiles like he knows your secrets.

skins.name: Opa Heinz
skins.story: Opa Heinz wears a brown jacket, grey trousers and a neat grey moustache, and he still walks the old roads every dawn.

skins.name: Opa Leopold
skins.story: Opa Leopold hides behind dark goggles and a full white beard, and his green robe with its golden collar smells of potions.

skins.name: Opa Walter
skins.story: Opa Walter shows up every winter in his red snowflake sweater, cheeks rosy, with presents nobody remembers wishing for.

versions.note: When winter came, four more chairs turned up by the fire. Gunter, Heinz, Leopold and Walter join the circle, bringing goggles, glasses and one very festive sweater.
